title: Most people think heaven is something you earn.
paragraphs: Most people think heaven is something you earn.

Do good.
Try harder.
Be religious enough.
But the Bible says something shocking:

You cannot earn heaven.
You can only receive it through Christ.

A lot of people believe heaven works like a scorecard:
good deeds vs bad deeds.
But the Bible says that’s not how salvation works.
It’s a gift God gives through Jesus.

If good works could save us…
why did Jesus have to die?
